INSERT INTO results (
                    student_id,
                    assessment_id,
                    marks_obtained,
                    grade,
                    result_status
                )
                VALUES ($1, $2, NULL, NULL, $3)
                ON CONFLICT (student_id, assessment_id)
                DO UPDATE SET
                    marks_obtained = NULL,
                    grade = NULL,
                    result_status = EXCLUDED.result_status,
                    updated_at = now()
